name: Intraday relative strength vs the index
hypothesis: A stock up at least 1% more than SPY since the open, holding above VWAP, keeps outperforming into the afternoon.

definition.name: Intraday relative strength vs the index

entry.long: close / session().open - sym($bench, close / session().open) > 0.01 and close > vwap() and minutes_since_open() >= 60
entry.short: close / session().open - sym($bench, close / session().open) < -0.01 and close < vwap() and minutes_since_open() >= 60
